module.title: Redis Runtime Cache, Ephemeral Security and Coordination
module.business_purpose: Contains only reconstructable or explicitly ephemeral state: sessions, challenges, rate limits, locks, caches, presence, job progress and consumer deduplication. Redis is never the sole source for clinical records, balances, stock, contracts, consent evidence or audit history.
